closed_set_membership: abs(R.T @ (point - c)) <= h, per axis; numerical halfspace tolerance 1e-12 metre. Raw vertices use corner sign order (-1,+1)^3.

verified_common_interior_ball.applicability: Same +30 physical state 1228. The entire ball is inside the left finger and the retained material of both registered ID7 beams.

coordinate_frame: Object geometric center, object-local +X/+Y/+Z; SI units. R maps geometry-local coordinates into the object frame.
load_path: The two registered root faces and beam/pillar connection faces themselves are separated from the hands at sampled poses. Connectivity or load capacity of a redesigned route, safety between samples, and interaction beyond the stops remain unverified.
necessary_condition: Any support intended to avoid the two recorded hand sweeps must exclude the observed occupied interiors. Both registered straight ID7 spans include the clipped positive volume at state 1228. Extending the same rooted cross-section preserves this intersection at that fixed state.
reconstruction_uncertainty: Raw per-step archive-vs-FK residuals are retained separately. They measure reproducibility of recorded kinematics, not a bound on real hardware or a between-step envelope.
sample_scope: Discrete poses only. Motion interpolation, between-step swept occupancy and future closed-loop trajectories are unknown.
sampled_forbidden_set: Union over the two recorded trajectories, sampled steps and left finger/right finger/palm of c + R q, |q_i| <= h_i.
spatial_bound_scope: A positive maximum SAT projection gap certifies separation and lower-bounds Euclidean distance. Actual clipped intersection volumes and vertices are reported separately.
